status: manual first-pass calibration annotations; not runtime integration
coordinateSystem: native source pixels, relative to full-image crop; height delta-y, widths are screen projected, not recovered physical widths

door.basis: measured: inner door opening apex to threshold top at door centre; stone arch/frame and threshold thickness excluded; the lower edge slopes across its width
door.assessment: At a224px adult reference the net door is1.25H. This source has no baked person, so one shared resident can be introduced without changing internal person/door ratios.

workWindow.clipBasis: inset quad inside posts, upper beam and sill; effective resident clip MUST subtract clipExcludePolygons or redraw their original source foreground after the resident. A four-corner quad alone cannot represent internal diagonal braces and bottles.
workWindow.safeSingleQuadNote: This conservative head/shoulder-only region avoids braces/bottles; at roughly70px high it is not the whole0.6H working window. Use the full quad with foreground exclusions for a full upper-body composition.
workWindow.basis: measured: black opening inner edge; posts, lintel, sill and potion silhouettes are separate source foreground. Manual bottle polygons are conservative and can hide a few extra resident pixels; do not cut or alter the source PNG.

axisBasis.W: measured: front rectangular entrance-step top front stone edge; not the round plinth arc; manual endpoint uncertainty about4px
axisBasis.D: measured: same step top right return edge; short41px horizontal span, hence direction less certain; not an independent full-building rigid-axis proof

ellipseBasis: inferred: circular main plinth visible side/front arcs; rear half hidden by building and front arc partly hidden by entrance steps. This is an occupancy envelope, not an independently measured complete horizontal circle.
groundBasis: conservative proxy L/F/R tangent parallelogram of the inferred plinth ellipse in the independently measured step-axis directions. These are NOT three visible physical corners. Supplied for existing ground+axes matrix readers: axes determine direction; ground determines conservative extent/fit.
contactBasis: manual: centre of the main plinth ground envelope, not door threshold or potion sill; entrance-step lower front corner is additional foreground depth.
projectionCaution: The source is nearly frontal. The rectangular step W slope is0.159 and D slope-0.683 before calibration, with a short uncertain D edge. Preserve upright verticals and inspect an actual grid projection; do not claim the inferred circle proves2:1 perspective.

normalizationProposal.windowResident: one standard adult, body behind sill; no children relabeling; source braces/bottles remain foreground

changesMade: Only this new JSON. Existing catalogues, source PNG, projection helper and runtime remain unchanged.
